Description: Lockdowns in China stop key starting materials; makers of metformin and amoxicillin API cut output by 60% for two months.
Power and road outages stop Juncos and its island suppliers for five weeks.
Pig herd losses cut crude heparin supply by half for three months.
A vaccine demand surge takes borosilicate tubing and Type I vial capacity for three months.

Scenario Name: FDA import alert on an API site
Description: Warning letter and import alert stop amoxicillin API for at least two months.
Freighter capacity on India–US air freight falls by a third and rates double for six weeks.
